{{Top|leg}}
The '''Temple of Stalsinek''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Stalsinek IV]] contained a magic fountain whose [[Water/Legends|waters]] were said to cure disease, restore limbs, and give youth to those who drank it. A local tribe of beings worshipped at the temple. Legends of the temple were considered tall tales throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
